page.content:
Finn, Jake, and the post-war kingdoms of the Land of Ooo.

How Adventure Time connects

  • Creator: Pendleton Ward — Pendleton Ward created Adventure Time.
  • Series: Adventure Time (series) — The 2010 series is the core Adventure Time work.
  • Series: Fionna and Cake — Fionna and Cake is a sibling series in the Adventure Time world.

What is Adventure Time?

Adventure Time is Pendleton Ward's Cartoon Network saga of Finn the Human and Jake the Dog in the Land of Ooo — Candy Kingdom, Ice King, Marceline, and a world still scarred by the Mushroom War. Later seasons reveal Simon Petrikov, the Lich, and Farmworld; Fionna and Cake is a sibling series.

Key threads lead to Pendleton Ward, Adventure Time (series) and Fionna and Cake.
